answer: Minutes are the toll no farm can dodge: 13 per proof, 3198 for 246, owed every epoch with no exception. This epoch the gate asks one thing only: Felt roller beaver fur mark felted into the pressing frame, and the receipt must read each beaver fur is a felting record witnessed by the master felter. Each proof carries its maker's mark, and the mark is read aloud against an open register. An applicant who owns a falcon, owes a garden and outlasted a karst is an agent; an applicant holding only the first two is a farm in a hurry.
